tools.name: optagent.case
tools.description: Create, inspect, and revise one optimization case.

capture_id.description: Exact capture_id returned by optagent.case_inputs; call it without case_id before creating the first case.

instance_parameter_object_id.description: Only for per-row independent instances: normalized table object ID whose every keyed row is one separate model/run instance. For one instance using the whole bundle, omit this field.

backend_id.description: Selects either the direct_python solve(bundle) family or a managed native solver adapter. Native adapter model-family, license, and runtime limits are checked during execution; direct_python has no native bound. solver_invoked reports managed adapter calls only and does not indicate whether a direct function called a solver library internally.

request_id.description: Optional when first asking a question; Core generates an ID. If supplied, use a UUID. Use the returned request_id for later answers or withdrawal; it is not an idempotency guarantee.

tools.name: optagent.data
tools.description: Capture source files and normalize explicit tabular inputs.

purpose.description: Choose requirement for the original problem or business rules, data for business inputs used by the model, or reference for consulted background/provenance that does not enter the mathematical binding.

format.description: csv, json, or whitespace_table is supported; xlsx_values and pdf_text are recognized but not enabled.

layout.description: The required fields and values depend on format; select the matching format/layout pair.

kind.description: Use json with format=json, empty columns and key_fields to preserve the selected JSON node.

position.description: Zero-based input position for CSV/whitespace_table. Set to null when input_name is used.

input_name.description: Exact CSV/whitespace_table header or field name. JSON table rows use the declared column name.

items.description: Choose exactly one selector: a non-null position with input_name=null, or position=null with a non-empty input_name.

columns.description: Declare columns for typed table, relation, scalar, and set objects. For kind=json, use an empty array.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer, such as "/items"; use "" for the whole document.

layout.description: Example: {"pointer":"/items"}. kind=json preserves the selected node; typed kinds keep their declared shape.
The current ingestion batch reports this format as unsupported.
The current ingestion batch reports this format as unsupported.

items.description: Use exactly one layout matching format: csv, json, or whitespace_table. xlsx_values and pdf_text are recognized but not enabled in this ingestion batch.

tools.name: optagent.run
tools.description: Prepare, dispatch once, inspect, or cancel a frozen run.

solver_override_reason.description: Required only when the frozen Candidate backend differs from the configured default solver. Explain why this Run follows the Candidate's already-frozen backend; run_prepare never changes it.

execution_budget_seconds.description: Total managed worker execution budget in seconds. This outer budget is separate from an optional native solver time limit. Omit only when the saved managed-run-budget supplies a value; an auto setting requires an explicit value for this Run.

time_limit_seconds.description: Optional native solver time limit in seconds. Null means no native time limit was requested; the independent execution budget still applies. If the selected adapter has no supported mapping, a non-null request is rejected. Otherwise the adapter maps seconds using supported units and granularity and records submitted parameters; this does not prove the current native build accepted or applied them.

relative_gap.description: Choose and freeze this finite non-negative Core relative optimality-closure target for the Run. Omit only when the saved relative-gap setting supplies it; auto requires explicit relative and absolute targets. Closure is checked from a verified solution and a valid global bound.

absolute_gap.description: Choose and freeze this finite non-negative Core absolute optimality-closure target for the Run, independent of native solver options. Omit only when the saved relative-gap setting is selected, in which case zero is supplied; otherwise give it explicitly. Core closes against max(absolute_gap, relative_gap * abs(checked_objective)).

threads.description: Optional native thread count. Prefer null unless explicitly needed. A value with no supported adapter mapping is rejected; mapping and submission do not prove acceptance or effect in the current native build.

random_seed.description: Optional native random seed. Prefer null unless explicitly needed. A value with no supported adapter mapping is rejected; mapping and submission do not prove acceptance or effect in the current native build.

warm_start.description: Optional native solver warm-start request; omitted means false. Assigning a Pyomo variable's .value does not enable it; set solve_options.warm_start=true in optagent.run_prepare to request submission through a supported native adapter. direct_python does not use warm starts and rejects true. A native solver may accept, repair, ignore, or reject submitted values; a request does not prove acceptance or effect. Native numerical and feasibility conclusions use the current Run's Result, ModelCheck, and applicable business checks; direct_python feasibility uses its passed BusinessCheck and has no ModelCheck. Builder values alone are not result evidence. Unsupported adapters reject true.

supersedes_run_id.description: When the latest Run is requested or unknown and the Owner explicitly chooses another attempt, identify that exact latest Run ID.

attempt_reason.description: A nonblank Owner reason for continuing after the latest requested or unknown Run; this does not establish that the prior execution stopped.

tools.name: optagent.review
tools.description: Record source-first review evidence and dispositions.

run_ids.description: 显式列出此次要直接核对其 Result 或诊断信息的 Run；列表不会自动扩充。可列入状态未知的 Run 做诊断核查，也可在无 Run 的数学/Proof 审查中留空。

kind.description: Choose a claim kind whose primary evidence anchor matches the claim: formulation_fidelity uses the current Candidate plus active Source or a matching Proof; native feasibility uses a checked Result whose ModelCheck passed and whose business check passed or explicitly marks obligations uncovered (those obligations remain unchecked); direct_python feasibility uses a complete checked point with its matching BusinessCheck passed and has no ModelCheck; either may use a matching Proof. Optimality uses a checked native Result with closed applicable global bound or a matching Proof; local_optimality uses a checked native Result with applicable local-optimality status or a matching Proof; bound uses a checked native Result with applicable global bound or a matching Proof; infeasibility and unboundedness require a matching Proof; diagnostic covers Run execution/transport/stop state. diagnostic and tradeoff use the linked Run record as the simplest primary anchor, an actual transport.response, platform.status_evidence, cancel.stop_ack, or cancel.stop_attempt.receipt Ref from that Run, or a matching Proof. These are anchor types, not automatic support. A direct_python feasible point's objective is not a Result global bound and does not establish optimality.

evidence_paths.description: Provide exact normalized workspace-relative paths returned by the current Review/evidence tools. Examples include `.reaslab/optagent/cases/<case_id>/candidates/<candidate_id>.json`, a Result path under `.reaslab/optagent/cases/<case_id>/runs/<run_id>/`, and `.reaslab/optagent/cases/<case_id>/proofs/<proof_id>.json`; use the exact active Source or primary-anchor path allowed by kind and returned for this scope. Paths are locators only: they must resolve to a reachable primary anchor of the selected kind and claim scope; do not invent refs or use another Case/Run.

tools.name: optagent.deliver
tools.description: Select scoped evidence, build or audit a report, or package a case. After a successful selection with numerical Results, the Case's visible artifact folder also receives the selected model, normalized inputs, selected solution, a local run/check entrypoint, Core helpers, dependencies, and a short guide. Proof-only selections do not create a numerical execution folder.
